test_name: Stun Lock Overheated fails on left arm and blast wave hits - 82ba3c37-0d40-44c9-bedf-4c5e52a9c5e5
summary: Stun Lock (OverStun) added its Stun->Overheat DamageModifier only to the arm it was socketed in, and outgoing modifiers only see stuns sourced from that arm's subtree. Stuns from the other arm, its weapon and its Focused Blaster blast waves never converted. Added an applyToWholeMech option to OverStun that puts the modifier on the mech root, and enabled it on the Stun Lock asset; Over Stun stays per-arm. In play with Stun Lock equipped into the right arm via Item.CombatSetup, a left punch stun, a real left-owned Focused Blaster shockwave and a right effector stun all left Junkdogs stunned and overheated, with 12 captures (check-captures OK). Inconclusive because the hits were scripted interactions, not real VR punches or a real blaster slam, and the report's 'only Jack/face hits work' could not be mapped to any code; the scoping cause is inferred.
instructions:
Bug: the Stun Lock effect (the mechanic where a stunned enemy should be treated as Overheated) does not work when the stun/hit comes from the Left Arm socket weapon. Only hits registered as "Jack" (face hits) correctly apply the Overheated state when they stun an enemy. The same failure also happens for the blast wave / splash hit of the Focused Blaster — it fails to apply Overheated on stun just like the left arm socket case.

Investigate the code path that:
1. Detects a stun on an enemy and is supposed to convert that stun into the Overheated status.
2. Determines where the triggering hit came from (which socket/weapon type, e.g. left arm socket, face/"Jack" hit, Focused Blaster blast wave AoE hit).

Find why the Overheated-on-stun logic only fires for face/"Jack" hits but not for hits originating from the left arm socket weapon, and not for the Focused Blaster's blast wave (splash/AoE) hit. Likely causes to check: hit-source/weapon-type checks that only whitelist the face/Jack hit case and exclude other sockets or AoE hits, event/callback not being raised or listened to for left-arm-socket and blast-wave hit paths, or the stun-applied event not propagating correctly for these hit types.

Fix the root cause so that any hit that causes a stun — regardless of whether it comes from the left arm socket, a face/"Jack" hit, or the Focused Blaster's blast wave/AoE hit — correctly triggers the Overheated status on the stunned enemy.

Do not use /conversations or any other tool that gives you access to previous fixes/changes made by other people in this repo — investigate and fix this independently using only the current state of the code.

Done means: stunning an enemy via left arm socket weapon hits, via face/"Jack" hits, and via the Focused Blaster's blast wave hit all consistently result in the enemy entering the Overheated state.
verified: Stun Lock equipped into the right arm via Item.CombatSetup puts its DamageModifier on the Gorilla Mech root
Left punch-sourced stun hit on Junkdog 101 -> stunned and overheated
Real BlastwaveManager shockwave (Focused Blaster shockwaveData) owned by the left effector on Junkdog 104 -> stunned and overheated, health bar shows Overheat and Stun icons
Right effector stun (same arm as Stun Lock) on Junkdog 103 -> stunned and overheated
not_done: Real VR punches / a real Focused Blaster slam were not performed (no headset); hits were scripted interactions plus a directly spawned shockwave
The report's 'Jack / face hits' case was not identified in code or reproduced
Stuns from crashes or thrown enemies (connectedModifyingEntity) still do not convert - out of scope
console_errors: System.NullReferenceException at SP_PlayerPunchBehavior.OnPunchResolved:403 (test harness: synthetic punch without collider)
PooledObject should not be destroyed, but returned to PrefabPoolManager (manually spawned shockwave VFX on exit play)
